item.title: Northrop Grumman’s MRV & MEPs Reach Geosynchronous Orbit
item.description: Northrop Grumman’s MRV and three MEPs launched on SpaceX’s Falcon 9, kicking off a decade‑long mission to service geosynchronous satellites in orbit.
